## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (paste the test count)
- [ ] `npm run qa` passes, if this touches `js/`, `css/`, `index.html` or `sw.js`
- [ ] New logic has a unit test; new user-visible behaviour has a browser check
- [ ] Existing studies keep behaving exactly as before (or the change is versioned)
- [ ] No personal data, recordings, exports or backups are included
- [ ] No network calls, analytics or externally loaded assets were added
- [ ] No safety limit or automatic pause was loosened (or the case is made above)
- [ ] `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated
